effect_description_eng: [Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] If it's your turn, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a level 4 Digimon card with the [Insectoid] or [Free] trait in your trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
